about_short_description.short_description: Provision is automating construction with AI.

product.name: Scope Agent
product.description: AI software that reviews construction drawings, specifications, contracts, addenda, and RFIs to identify scope gaps and generate trade-organized scope packages for bidding.

product.name: Risk Review
product.description: AI-powered contract and bid-document analysis that identifies risky clauses, missing scope, and commercial exposures, with citations and standardized review positions.

product.name: Chat Agent
product.description: Construction-focused document Q&A software that answers questions across drawings, specifications, contracts, RFIs, and addenda with links to the exact source pages and sections.
